source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent soda can progressing from pale construction to bold felt-tip outlines and saturated marker color.
source.notes: Keep one upright three-quarter aluminum can with one top ellipse, one bottom curve, one pull tab and opening, two blank diagonal label bands, exactly five fizz bubbles, three short motion ticks, two highlight gaps, and one shallow shadow stable. The first approved drawing arrived on a square overall canvas and is preserved privately as cartoon-soda-can-with-fizz-square-layout-v1.png; a layout-only edit reformatted the same sequence into a 3:2 sheet with square cells before cropping. No brand, letters, face, straw, cup, bottle, sticker border, badge frame, signature, watermark, or final-only feature.

process_strategy: Lock the can's cylinder, top ellipse, pull-tab footprint, two label-band routes, fizz arc, and shadow before outlining; add all hardware and bubbles before inking; then color only established shapes so the finish stays cumulative, face-free, and visibly handmade.

final_elements.name: can cylinder, top ellipse, pull-tab, label-band, fizz, and shadow guides
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one upright can, its three-quarter top, tab reserve, two diagonal band routes, five-bubble fizz arc, and shallow shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete soda-can silhouette with top rim and bottom curve
final_elements.description: One slightly tapered can body wraps the guides with a readable top ellipse and curved lower edge.

final_elements.name: pull tab, can opening, center rivet, and two blank diagonal label bands
final_elements.description: Simple top hardware and two text-free sweeping bands give the can material and graphic structure.

final_elements.name: exactly five fizz bubbles, three motion ticks, two highlight gaps, and shallow shadow
final_elements.description: Five unequal bubbles rise from the opening along the reserved arc, supported by three short ticks, two paper highlights, and one grounded shadow.

final_elements.name: thick black outline and coral, teal, pale-butter, gray, and golden marker fills
final_elements.description: Imperfect felt-tip outlines and saturated but limited marker fills clarify every established contour while preserving streaks and paper gaps.

rejection_checks: The same upright three-quarter can, crop, scale, top ellipse, body taper, tab position, label bands, and fizz arc must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one can, one pull tab and opening, two blank label bands, five bubbles, three motion ticks, and two highlight gaps must appear before the final panel and persist.
No brand, letter, word, logo, face, straw, cup, bottle, extra prop, sticker outline, badge frame, signature, watermark, or final-only motif may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip texture and handmade edge variation rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
